question.text: EV/EBITDA is preferred over P/E when comparing:

answer.text: Companies with different debt structures in capital-intensive industries

explanation.text: The Logic: EV/EBITDA is best suited for capital-intensive industries and for comparing companies with different debt structures because EBITDA is unaffected by capital structure; it is commonly used for M&A and LBO analyses. The Trap: When capital structures are identical, P/E and EV/EBITDA tend to give similar signals; the EV/EBITDA edge appears where leverage differs materially. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-A PMS Distributors workbook, p.52 (EV/EBITDA); p.49 (capital structure context).
